description: Number of cyclists and pedestrians in Espoo is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Espoon kaupungin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. The dataset contains information on the number of cyclists and pedestrians in Espoo. The data is available in two different formats: in CSV tables (Number of cyclists and locations of bicycle counting places) and on the map as a geographic dataset through the WFS API (Pedestrian and cycling traffic counters, pedestrian and cycling counting results). Coverage: Espoon kaupungin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. The publisher named on the listing is Espoon kaupungin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. Its keywords include bicycling, liikenne, cykling, cycling, cyklar, pyöräily. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
